answer: Clone keys can copy a pledge, but they cannot all redeem one scarce chip. Each epoch the desk mints 40 numbered marble tokens. An applicant locks 17.8 POA and first publishes a cipher equal to SHA-256(chip_serial || 80-byte clip from meadow gate G-3 || address), then must draw that exact chip at window 14 and play the clip within 25 minutes. Five stewards drawn from SHA-256(epoch_seed||slot||k), k=0..4, replay the file and match the serial. A reused chip, a late draw, or a hash mismatch slashes 7.6 POA and bars the key for six epochs; 10.2 POA returns after four quiet epochs.
